cad.opening: Joints, penetrations and cut-outs remain explicit
cad.load: Sheet self-weight to framing through fixings

notes: Fire-protective grade may be part of an accepted acoustic build-up, but colour or product name alone does not establish either complete system rating.

objects.name: sound-insulating fibre-cement lining sheet
objects.definition: A fibre-cement sheet installed as a mass layer in a prescribed or tested acoustic wall construction, commonly combined with another lining layer.
functions: Form part of a multi-layer acoustic lining

cad.pattern: Dense sheet layer on acoustic frame
cad.placement: On selected wall face below or above another lining
cad.opening: Cut-outs and layer joints remain explicit
cad.load: Sheet self-weight to framing

objects.name: sound-insulating cement-render layer
objects.definition: A continuous dense cementitious render applied to a masonry face as part of a specified acoustic wall configuration.

cad.pattern: Continuous layer on masonry face
cad.placement: On specified outside face of masonry acoustic leaf
cad.opening: Joints and penetrations are sealed explicitly
cad.load: Render self-weight and bond to masonry

objects.name: sound-absorptive wall-cavity insulation layer
objects.definition: A continuous fitted field of glass mineral wool, rock mineral wool or polyester insulation occupying the selected part of an acoustic wall cavity without rigidly bridging separate leaves.
functions: Absorb sound energy within the cavity
Maintain the selected tested or prescribed build-up

cad.pattern: Fitted insulation field within selected cavity or stud row
cad.placement: Between frame members or masonry leaves as documented
cad.opening: Gaps and service interruptions remain explicit
cad.load: Light self-weight to cavity supports

notes: Material, density and thickness belong to the selected evidence; visual similarity to a thermal batt is insufficient.

objects.name: sound-insulating lining fixing
objects.definition: A screw, nail or proprietary fastener fixing an acoustic sheet layer to its assigned frame, channel or support without bridging an isolated wall leaf unintentionally.
functions: Maintain the selected layer and support relationship
not_synonyms: ordinary long screw across both leaves

cad.pattern: Repeated fasteners on assigned support grid
cad.placement: Through lining into frame or channel
cad.opening: Does not reach opposite isolated leaf
cad.load: Lining actions to support

objects.name: sound-insulating lining joint tape
objects.definition: Paper, fibre or mesh tape embedded over a joint between acoustic lining sheets as part of a filled, airtight joint treatment.

cad.pattern: Linear tape over every treated sheet joint
cad.opening: Continuous around corners and terminations as selected
cad.load: Non-structural joint reinforcement

objects.name: sound-insulating lining joint compound
objects.definition: A setting or drying compound filling sheet joints, fastener heads and tape beds to form a continuous sealed lining face.

cad.pattern: Filled linear joint and local fastener patches
cad.opening: No residual open joint
cad.load: Non-structural surface fill

objects.name: acoustic perimeter sealant joint
objects.definition: A continuous flexible sealant bead closing the designed gap between an acoustic lining, frame or masonry panel and adjacent floor, wall, ceiling or roof construction.
functions: Close air and sound leakage paths

cad.pattern: Continuous bead around acoustic element perimeter
cad.placement: Between acoustic construction and adjoining surfaces
cad.opening: No unsealed breaks
cad.load: Flexible non-structural seal

notes: Where a joint is also fire-resisting, the selected product and complete joint must support both roles.

objects.name: acoustic joint backing material
objects.definition: A compressible backing rod, mineral-fibre packing or other specified material controlling sealant depth and filling the concealed portion of an acoustic perimeter gap.

cad.pattern: Compressed linear backing behind seal
cad.opening: Does not create rigid bridge across discontinuity
cad.load: Supports sealant and packing only

objects.name: acoustic resilient lining channel
objects.definition: A thin formed metal channel supporting wall or ceiling lining through a flexible offset intended to reduce direct vibration transfer from the primary frame.

cad.pattern: Repeated parallel resilient channels
cad.opening: Lining screws terminate in channel and avoid primary frame where required
cad.load: Lining weight through resilient channel to primary support

notes: A section's appearance does not prove resilient performance; use selected-system evidence and fixing details.

objects.name: acoustic lining isolation clip
objects.definition: A discrete bracket containing an elastomeric or spring element that connects a furring channel or lining support to structure while reducing vibration transfer.

cad.pattern: Repeated discrete supports on frame grid
cad.opening: No bypass fixing rigidly connects lining to structure
cad.load: Lining actions through resilient element

objects.name: service within sound-insulating separating wall assembly
objects.definition: A duct, soil, waste, water, stormwater or electrical service located in or passing through an acoustic separating wall, together with its assigned leaf, supports, clearances, access and sealed penetrations.
functions: Carry the service without short-circuiting wall separation
Maintain wall sound performance at supports and penetrations

cad.pattern: Service route assigned to one wall side with explicit supports and closures
cad.placement: Inside or through separating wall where permitted
cad.opening: Penetrations and access doors remain explicit
cad.load: Service weight and vibration through selected resilient support path

notes: The national provisions prohibit chasing services into concrete or masonry separating walls; exact local paths must be checked.

objects.name: sound-insulating service access panel assembly
objects.definition: A dense fixed or openable door or panel, overlapping or rebated frame and perimeter seal providing maintenance access to a permitted service within acoustic separating construction.
functions: Close the access opening with adequate mass and overlap
Limit air and sound leakage around the opening

cad.pattern: Dense panel closing rebated framed opening
cad.opening: Open and closed states remain explicit
cad.load: Panel weight to frame; seal compression at perimeter

notes: Room-side restrictions and exact panel construction remain current-clause inputs.

objects.name: sound-insulating service access door or panel leaf
objects.definition: The dense removable or hinged panel closing an acoustic service access opening and overlapping or seating into its frame rebate.
functions: Permit removal or opening for maintenance

cad.pattern: Dense panel matching access frame
cad.opening: Maintenance opening clears when panel is open
cad.load: Panel weight to hinges, fasteners or frame seat

objects.name: sound-insulating service access panel frame
objects.definition: A continuous frame around an acoustic service opening, formed with a rebate or overlap seat and fixed to the surrounding wall construction.
functions: Carry hinges, latches and perimeter seals

cad.pattern: Closed rectangular or shaped frame
cad.opening: Clear maintenance opening remains explicit
cad.load: Panel and hardware actions to wall

objects.name: sound-insulating access-panel perimeter seal
objects.definition: A continuous compressible gasket or sealant line between an acoustic access panel leaf and its frame seat.
functions: Close the operable perimeter air path
Accommodate repeated opening and closing where applicable

cad.pattern: Closed gasket loop around access opening
cad.placement: Between panel edge and frame rebate
cad.opening: Continuous without uncompressed corners
cad.load: Compression from closed panel

objects.name: acoustically isolated water-supply pipe in separating wall
objects.definition: A water-supply pipe serving one dwelling, located only where the selected discontinuous wall path permits, supported from its own dwelling-side leaf with clearance from the other leaf.
functions: Avoid rigid connection to the neighbouring leaf
Limit vibration and water-flow sound transfer

cad.pattern: Pipe route fixed only to assigned wall leaf
cad.opening: Clearance to opposite leaf remains measurable
cad.load: Pipe weight and vibration through resilient supports to assigned leaf

objects.name: acoustic resilient pipe clip
objects.definition: A pipe saddle or clamp containing a resilient liner or isolation element between the pipe and supporting wall, frame or bracket.
functions: Reduce vibration transfer into the building element

cad.pattern: Repeated lined supports on pipe route
cad.placement: Between pipe and assigned wall or frame
cad.opening: No rigid bypass around liner
cad.load: Pipe weight through resilient liner to support

objects.name: acoustic pipe or duct wrap
objects.definition: A flexible mass, absorptive or composite lagging wrapped continuously around a pipe or duct to reduce radiated service noise where the selected design requires it.
functions: Maintain continuous treatment around bends and fittings

cad.pattern: Concentric flexible layer around service
cad.placement: Along selected pipe or duct route
cad.opening: No unrecorded gaps at bends, branches or supports
cad.load: Wrap self-weight to service and supports

notes: Coordinate fire collars and other tested firestop devices; do not wrap across them unless the system permits it.

objects.name: acoustic pipe-wrap closure tape
objects.definition: A compatible pressure-sensitive or reinforced tape closing laps, longitudinal seams and local patches in acoustic pipe or duct wrap.

cad.pattern: Linear seam tape and circumferential bands
cad.placement: On acoustic wrap laps and terminations
cad.opening: No open wrap seam
cad.load: Retains light flexible wrap layers

objects.name: acoustic flexible pipe or duct connector
objects.definition: A flexible coupling or connector inserted in a pipe or duct route to limit structure-borne vibration transfer through otherwise rigid service construction.
functions: Reduce vibration transmission along the service

cad.pattern: Short flexible section between rigid service runs
cad.placement: At selected equipment or boundary connection
cad.opening: No rigid strap or connection bypasses flexible element
cad.load: Service pressure and movement through connector

objects.name: sound-insulating wall electrical-outlet treatment assembly
objects.definition: An electrical outlet or switch box and its wall cut-out, backing, air seal or putty treatment, mounting and offset relationship arranged to preserve the sound-insulating wall construction.
functions: Close leakage around the box and cut-out

cad.pattern: Box and treatment nested within one wall leaf
cad.placement: At scheduled switch or outlet position
cad.opening: Opposite-side outlet offset is a measured relationship
cad.load: Accessory actions to assigned wall leaf

notes: Electrical safety and installation belong to the later electrical slice; the acoustic model preserves the physical weak point and treatment.

objects.name: sound-rated wall electrical mounting box
objects.definition: A surface-mounted or recessed electrical box selected and installed as part of a documented acoustic wall treatment.
functions: Provide a sealable box perimeter and cable entry

cad.pattern: Closed or close-fitting box at lining cut-out
cad.placement: On or within one acoustic wall leaf
cad.opening: Cut-out and entries receive explicit seals
cad.load: Accessory weight to wall support

objects.name: electrical-box acoustic putty or barrier pad
objects.definition: A mouldable pad or preformed barrier enclosing the back and sides of an electrical box to restore mass and close local leakage paths in a documented acoustic wall system.
functions: Add local mass around the box
Seal irregular box edges and entries
Limit sound leakage through the recess

cad.pattern: Moulded layer around box back and sides
cad.placement: Between electrical box and acoustic cavity
cad.opening: Cable entries are wrapped and sealed
cad.load: Adhered or retained flexible barrier

notes: A product may perform fire and acoustic roles only where its tested system supports both.

objects.name: electrical-box acoustic caulk seal
objects.definition: A continuous acoustic sealant bead closing the gap between an electrical box, lining cut-out, cable entry or supporting surface.
functions: Connect the box treatment to the lining face

cad.pattern: Closed bead around box or cable entry
cad.opening: No residual gap around box
cad.load: Flexible non-structural seal

objects.name: sound-insulating ceiling termination assembly
objects.definition: A ceiling construction documented to provide the sound insulation required where a sound-insulating wall terminates at the ceiling instead of continuing to the roof underside.
functions: Close the flanking path above the wall
Connect the wall top to ceiling layers and perimeter seals

cad.pattern: Continuous layered ceiling across and beside wall top
cad.placement: At selected wall termination below roof
cad.opening: Every light, grille, hatch and service penetration is treated
cad.load: Ceiling actions through selected support path

notes: Do not assume a standard decorative ceiling has the required sound performance.

objects.name: room-height bounding construction assembly
objects.definition: The actual finished floor surface, ceiling lining or underside of construction above, and every beam, bulkhead, duct or other projection that bounds the usable room-height measurement.
functions: Define the physical lower and upper measurement surfaces
attributes: stair nosing line or ramp surface

ncc_references.relationship: Room and route heights are measured from actual finished lower surfaces to ceiling linings, underside construction or local projections.

cad.pattern: Paired lower and upper surfaces with projection map
cad.placement: Within each classified room, corridor, stair, ramp and landing
cad.opening: Height volumes are computed overlays rather than solids
cad.load: Physical surfaces retain their normal structural and finish roles

notes: A ceiling-height number cannot replace the actual sloping faces, soffits and projections needed for an area-based check.

objects.name: internal ceiling lining assembly
objects.definition: The visible internal ceiling sheets or panels, support battens or channels, fixings, joints, perimeter trims and access openings below roof or floor structure.
functions: Form the room's upper finished surface
Support acoustic, fire, air-sealing or wet-area roles where selected

cad.pattern: Sheet or panel field below supporting structure
cad.opening: Hatches, lights, grilles and shafts remain explicit
cad.load: Ceiling self-weight and fixtures to battens, joists or channels

objects.name: internal plasterboard ceiling sheet
objects.definition: A gypsum plasterboard sheet fixed to ceiling joists, battens, furring channels or resilient supports as a visible or base ceiling layer.

cad.pattern: Repeated sheets across ceiling support grid
cad.opening: Every fixture and access cut-out remains explicit
cad.load: Sheet self-weight to supports through fixings

objects.name: internal ceiling bulkhead assembly
objects.definition: A framed and lined downward projection below the main ceiling, commonly enclosing structure, ducts, pipes, curtains, lighting or a change in ceiling level.

cad.pattern: Framed box or stepped soffit below ceiling
cad.placement: At room perimeter or across room
cad.opening: Access panels and service outlets remain explicit
cad.load: Bulkhead self-weight and fixtures to ceiling or wall structure

notes: The bulkhead is physical construction; the reduced-height area below it is a calculated region.

objects.name: ceiling bulkhead frame
objects.definition: The timber or cold-formed-steel studs, tracks, battens and hangers forming the support skeleton of a ceiling bulkhead.

cad.pattern: Linear frame around bulkhead volume
cad.opening: Frames around services and hatches
cad.load: Bulkhead and fixture loads to building structure

objects.name: ceiling bulkhead lining sheet
objects.definition: A sheet forming the vertical, horizontal or shaped visible faces of an internal ceiling bulkhead.

cad.pattern: Sheets on bulkhead frame faces
cad.opening: Service and access cut-outs remain explicit
cad.load: Sheet self-weight to bulkhead frame

objects.name: internal ceiling cornice
objects.definition: A continuous moulded or profiled trim covering and finishing the junction between an internal ceiling lining and wall lining.
functions: Cover the lining edge and joint
Contribute to air or acoustic sealing only where detailed

cad.pattern: Continuous moulding along wall-ceiling junction
cad.opening: Stops around openings and bulkheads are explicit
cad.load: Light finish retained by adhesive or fixings

notes: A cornice can hide a gap visually without necessarily providing the acoustic or air seal required behind it.

objects.name: internal ceiling access panel assembly
objects.definition: A framed removable, hinged or drop-in panel closing an opening in the ceiling lining for access to the roof space or concealed services.
functions: Coordinate insulation, air, acoustic or fire treatments around the hatch

cad.pattern: Panel seated in framed ceiling opening
cad.placement: At scheduled service or roof-space access point
cad.opening: Clear opening and access route remain explicit
cad.load: Panel weight to frame; frame to ceiling supports

notes: An access hatch through an acoustic ceiling needs the same evidence-based treatment as the ceiling system; a generic loose panel can compromise it.
